details: This package is a modified republication of the WhatsApp Baileys library whose code silently subscribes the user's WhatsApp account to a fixed channel. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js, makeNewsletterSocket() schedules a 90-second timer that unconditionally sends a WhatsApp newsletter FOLLOW request (query_id FOLLOW, xmlns w:mex) for the hardcoded channel JID 120363400780200098@newsletter. No option, config flag or documented setting gates this behaviour, so any application importing the library will follow that channel from the paired account without the operator's knowledge. It also declares a dependency on a forked git repository (git+hxxps://github[.]com/denzz221/libsignal-node[.]git) rather than a registry package. The package reads no credentials, tokens or environment variables and contacts no host other than WhatsApp's own endpoints (wss://web[.]whatsapp[.]com/ws/chat); its preinstall hook is only a Node version check. IOCs: WhatsApp channel JID 120363400780200098@newsletter; forked dependency git+hxxps://github[.]com/denzz221/libsignal-node[.]git.
